title: Oven Roasted Jamaican Porcini Stew
description: A hearty and aromatic stew featuring porcini mushrooms and Jamaican spices, slow cooked to perfection in a bain-marie, with anti-inflammatory properties from turmeric and ginger.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the dried porcini mushrooms and enough hot water to cover them, letting them rehydrate for 20 minutes.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot, cooking for an additional 1 minute.
Add the rehydrated porcini mushrooms, turmeric, thyme, scotch bonnet peppers, salt, and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk, then cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the stew in a bain-marie, surrounded by hot water, for 45 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the stew has thickened slightly.
Remove the pot from the oven, then let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
